cohort: The study included 128 women in their first seven months after childbirth.
finding: Vaginal birth is associated with reduced pelvic floor muscle strength, while previous UI during pregnancy and higher newborn weights increase the likelihood of postpartum UI, and AI prior to pregnancy is the sole risk factor for postpartum AI.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth predisposes to the reduction of PFMS, whereas caesarean section offers a protective effect against its reduction.
